ERR_PROV_NOT_FOUND.label: Provider not found
ERR_PROV_NOT_FOUND.description: No provider registered under this id.
ERR_PROV_NOT_FOUND.action: Create or check the provider list first.

ERR_PROV_EXISTS.label: Provider id in use
ERR_PROV_EXISTS.description: Another provider already uses this id.
ERR_PROV_EXISTS.action: Pick another provider id or remove the existing one.

ERR_PROV_IN_USE.label: Provider in use
ERR_PROV_IN_USE.description: The provider has an active RX owner or a send in progress.
ERR_PROV_IN_USE.action: Close or wait for sends to finish before opening or removing.

ERR_PROV_SYSTEM.label: System provider
ERR_PROV_SYSTEM.description: Board system providers cannot be removed.
ERR_PROV_SYSTEM.action: Do not attempt to remove system providers.

ERR_PROV_DOWN.label: Provider down
ERR_PROV_DOWN.action: Reconnect the underlying transport before sending.

ERR_PROV_TOO_LONG.label: Frame too long
ERR_PROV_TOO_LONG.description: Frame exceeds CMD_FRAME_MAX and will not be fragmented.

ERR_PROV_SEND.label: Send failed
ERR_PROV_SEND.description: Underlying driver failed to transmit the frame.

ERR_PROV_BUSY.label: Provider busy
ERR_PROV_BUSY.description: Driver transmit queue could not accept the frame.
ERR_PROV_BUSY.action: Retry later or check link backpressure.

ERR_PROV_NO_RX.label: No RX hook
ERR_PROV_NO_RX.description: Provider does not deliver frames through the RX hook.
ERR_PROV_NO_RX.action: Open with rx == NULL and read from the underlying driver.

ERR_PROV_BAD_ID.label: Invalid provider id
ERR_PROV_BAD_ID.description: SYS_DATA_PROVIDER_ID_NONE (0xFF) passed to an instance op, or instance id passed to LIST.
ERR_PROV_BAD_ID.action: Use 0..0xFE for providers and 0xFF for LIST.

ERR_PROV_TYPE_UNKNOWN.label: Unknown provider type
ERR_PROV_TYPE_UNKNOWN.description: No self-registered driver exists for this provider type (u8).

ERR_PROV_UNKNOWN_OP.label: Unknown provider op
ERR_PROV_UNKNOWN_OP.description: Op not supported by this provider or invalid direction for the op.

ERR_PROV_LOCAL_OP.label: Local provider op
ERR_PROV_LOCAL_OP.description: C-only LOCAL op invoked through the router.
ERR_PROV_LOCAL_OP.action: Call LOCAL ops directly from firmware C.

ERR_PROV_NO_MEM.label: Out of memory
ERR_PROV_NO_MEM.description: Failed to allocate driver context during CREATE.
ERR_PROV_NO_MEM.action: Free heap memory or reduce active providers.
